tools.description: 等待已委派的子代理并取回结果：每个句柄的状态（completed / failed / running）、子代理的总结与提交情况。 mode=all 等全部结束（默认），mode=any 等任意一个结束；省略 handles 时，等本次运行里还没取回过结果的子代理。 timeoutSeconds 可限定最长等待时间，到时仍在运行的标为 running。

tools.name: evimed_delegate
tools.description: 把一件交付物委派给能力目录中的一项能力：启动一个子代理后立即返回句柄（handle），不等它完成；用 evimed_await 取回结果。 默认不用它：一件交付物就在这次对话里做完。值得委派的只有两种情况——同时有多件互相独立的活可以并行，或者一段附带工作会带回大量你不会再用的内容。 子代理带着该能力的技能正文、工具集与人设启动，把文件写进 deliverables/<交付物 id>/ 并自行提交。互不依赖的交付物可以一起委派，它们会同时进行。 它依赖的交付物还没有交付时，委派会被拒绝，并告诉你还差哪一件。 委派前不要替子代理检索、读取来源或预写交付文件；需要证据时，让同一个子代理完成完整证据链。

prose.description: 同时返回报告正文的形状。默认不返回。

tools.name: mcp__evimed__literature_search
tools.description: Search the biomedical and scientific literature (PubMed and the other configured sources) through the EviMed evidence adapter. By default the answer leads with PubMed's Best Match records and adds the EviMed index's records that PubMed did not return (up to `limit` from each; an index record is compact — abstract cut to 800 characters, no AI summary); `databases` ["pubmed"] asks PubMed alone and ["internal"] asks the EviMed index alone with its full abstracts and AI summaries. Supply `relation` instead to retrieve the literature PubTator3 records a relation in — papers that assert the relation, not papers where both terms merely co-occur; get the concept identifiers from term_normalize. Supply `pmids` instead to fetch the abstracts, publication types and MeSH headings of PubMed records you have screened in (up to 60); each abstract is preserved and quotable, and past about 12,000 characters an item names its preserved file instead of carrying the text. Public results are bibliographic metadata unless abstract or full-text fields are explicitly present; never infer study design, evidence level, outcomes, or effect estimates from a title.

When Europe PMC is unavailable (an error status or no answer in time) NCBI PMC serves the same JATS instead and the result says so (data.route ncbi-pmc-xml, data.fallbackFrom); a refusal such as not open access is never retried elsewhere. data.contentLevel says what the text is; an abstract is never full text. supplements=true also fetches the article's supplementary files, checks each against the md5 the article declares and preserves them (up to ~150 s; a cut-short archive keeps the files that arrived whole). intake=true hands the text and supplements to the project's knowledge base. Refusals, timeouts and no-supplement answers are named in data.outcome and data.supplementaryFiles.
